newsitem.title: USA: Connecticut man charged with murdering fiancee.
newsitem.headline: Connecticut man charged with murdering fiancee.

text.p: A Norwalk, Connecticut, man was indicted Wednesday for the March 11 kidnapping and murder of his fiancee who had obtained a protective order against him the previous day.

A Manhattan federal jury indicted Deric Frank, 23, for forcibly abducting Shaneika Price, 24, from her job in Stamford, Connecticut, locking her in the truck of her own car and transporting her to Manhattan.
While Price was still locked in the trunk, Frank allegedly parked on an exit ramp of the Cross-Bronx Expressway and set the car on fire.
Frank has been charged with four separate violations of the Violence Against Women Act in addition to kidnapping and conspiracy.
If convicted, Frank faces a possible death sentence under federal kidnapping laws or life in prison.
He was arraigned on separate drug charges on Wednesday in Connecticut state court in Norwalk.
